name: Hearts Against the Tide
description: A cheap, much-thumbed romance from Mirela's back table: a harbour pilot, a lighthouse keeper's daughter and a storm that cannot be blamed for everything. Cover price twenty-five crowns.
notes: mw-m97i: Inspector Cray's secret weakness (bible 5.13). Offered to her at the customs desk; she takes it for the evidence room. Value 25 sits in the cheap-goods end of the economy bands; owner to confirm. Placement (Mirela's table, Nell's crate) is mw-r5nw/mw-ily9.
